// diagnostic

E3414

Fetch failed / bad argument / non-UTF-8 content (message varies).

What

Fetch failed / bad argument / non-UTF-8 content (message varies).

Why

Common causes: unsupported URL scheme (only `file://`, `http://`, `https://`), unreachable host, missing `sha256:` argument, or binary content (use `embed_bytes` for that). HTTPS TLS failures use E4201–E4203.

Fix

check the URL and arguments; use `file://` for local test paths.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3414: tests/ui/comptime_net_fetch_bad_url.stderr.

Error [E3414]: fetch failed: unsupported URL scheme `ftp`; expected `file://`, `http://`, or `https://`
  --> tests/ui/comptime_net_fetch_bad_url.jet:3:14
    |
  3 | @data :: net.fetch("ftp://example.com/data.txt", sha256: "abc")
    |              ^^^^^
 Why: could not retrieve `ftp://example.com/data.txt`
 Fix: check the URL is reachable and the network is available; use `file://` for local paths
